a. 
(-र्षी f.) [ऋषेरिदं अण्] 
__1 Used by a Ṛṣi only, relating or belonging to sages, beneficial to sages; शमो दमस्तथा धैर्यं सत्यं शौचमथार्जवम् । यज्ञो घृतिश्च धर्मश्च नित्यमार्षो बिधिः स्मृतः ॥ [[
]]; archaic, Vedic (opp. लौकिक or classical); आर्षः प्रयोगः; संबुद्धौ शाकल्यस्येताबनार्षे [[

.]] 
__2 Sacred, holy, divine, superhuman; आदिकाव्यमिदं चार्षं पुरा वाल्मीकिना कृतम् [[

.]] 
-र्षः A form of marriage derived from the Ṛṣis; one of the eight [Page0357-2] forms of marriage in which the father of the bride receives one or two pairs of cows from the bridegroom; आदायार्षस्तु गोद्वयम् [[

]], 9. 196; for the names of the 8 forms see उद्वाह; आर्षोढा a wife married according to this form. 
-र्षा A class of Vedic metres. 
-र्षम् 
__1 The holy text, the Vedas; आर्षं धर्मोपदेशं च वेदशास्त्राविरोधिना [[

.]] 
__2 Sacred descent. 
__3 Derivation (of a poem) from a Ṛṣi author. आर्षंधरम् N. of a Sāman.

.]]

-घ्न a. destroying piles. 
(-घ्नः) 
__1 N. of the plant शुरण (Mar. सुरण), so called because it is said to cure piles. 
__2 one part of butter-milk with three parts of water. 
(-घ्नी) 
__1 N. of the plant Curculigo Archioides Lin. (Mar. देवडंगरी). 
__2 the marking nut plant (भल्लातक). 
-युज् a. afflicted with piles. 
-हित a. curing piles. 
(-तः) the marking nut plant; (Mar. बिब्बा).
